---
name: "nf-core/bam_stats_samtools"
description: "Produces comprehensive statistics from SAM/BAM/CRAM file"
keywords:
- "statistics"
- "counts"
- "bam"
- "sam"
- "cram"
components:
- "samtools/stats"
- "samtools/idxstats"
- "samtools/flagstat"
input:
- ch_bam_bai:
    description: "The input channel containing the BAM/CRAM and it's index\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(bam), path(bai) ]\n"
- ch_fasta_fai:
    description: "Reference genome fasta file and its index\nStructure: [ val(meta2),\
      \ path(fasta), path(fai) ]\n"
output:
- stats:
    description: "File containing samtools stats output\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(stats)\
      \ ]\n"
- flagstat:
    description: "File containing samtools flagstat output\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(flagstat) ]\n"
- idxstats:
    description: "File containing samtools idxstats output\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(idxstats)]\n"
authors:
- "@drpatelh"
maintainers:
- "@drpatelh"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/samtools/stats@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/samtools/idxstats@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/samtools/flagstat@0.0.0-df69bf6"
